# AEO Ready (AEOReady.xyz)

> AEO Ready (https://aeoready.xyz) is an open source platform that audits what AI models
> (ChatGPT, Grok, Gemini, Claude) can read from a website and provides actionable,
> copy-pasteable code fixes (JSON-LD structured data, `llms.txt`, `robots.txt` diffs)
> to optimize visibility in generative search.

## Overview
- [Home](https://aeoready.xyz): Audit any URL for AEO readiness
- [Documentation](/docs/prd.md): Product architecture and technical specification
- [GitHub Integration](/lib/linkup.js): Linkup search and competitor retrieval client

## Core Capabilities
- **Technical Audit**: Crawler access (robots.txt, HTTP status, sitemap), structured data (schema.org JSON-LD), agent surfaces (llms.txt, Content Signals)
- **Live AI Visibility**: Measures citation share across major AI answer engines for real category queries
- **Automated Fix Generation**: Pre-built JSON-LD schemas, robots.txt directives, and markdown fix plans
